page.title: Review action drafts
page.intro: Expand fields to inspect the source. Resolve highlighted issues before saving.
page.merged: Merged. Open the target action to inspect or undo the change.
page.sourceHelp: Select a field to locate its sentence

issue.title: The title is missing. Add one after checking the source.
issue.missing: No owner was named. Choose one after checking the source.
issue.ambiguous: This shorthand matches several people. Choose the correct owner.
issue.unknown: No directory match. Select an owner manually.
issue.vague: The wording gives a range. Confirm a specific due date.
issue.date: No valid due date was found. Supply a date.
issue.conflict: The source gives conflicting values. Confirm the correct one.
issue.duplicate: The owner, title and due date match an existing action.
